messages:
Priya: Heads-up: need final prioritization for Optimize toolkit features for next dev cycle: batching heuristics, prefix caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Quick brainstorm?

Emma: For batching+cache acceptance I'll define perf targets. Suggest p99 latency budget and three cost bands (15/30/50%).

Oliver: SRE risks: cache eviction storms & memory spikes if batches coalesce. Recommend staged canary + rate caps and automatic fallback.

Jason: Ops needs: pilot enrollment UX, feature flags, telemetry schema. Proposing alpha (invite-only) and beta (broader).

Miguel: Customers want simple defaults: "latency vs cost" presets and per-route quant suggestions. AcmeHealth interested in early alpha.

Priya: Draft acceptance criteria: batching -> >=15% cost reduction on pilot without exceeding p99 SLO; cache -> documented TTL/invalidation + >=99% correctness on cached prefixes; quant recs -> <=3% impact on primary metric or opt-out; eval alerts -> configurable thresholds, sample export, slack/email hooks.

Emma: I'll add example config snippet and benchmark table to the spec.

Oliver: I'll add rollback hooks and playbook to the PR.

Jason: Legal needs to review telemetry (possible +1 week). Scheduling review Thurs 11am.

Priya: Timeline: spec PR by Tue, alpha invites by Fri, pilot target in two sprints. Tagging owners.

deploy-bot: created doc: https://redwood/drive/optimize-toolkit-prio-draft
